Status: Wave 259 accepted (6.3): Plugin, Operations.SplitAndMerge, GroupAddressRefs and Filtertable (plus two collision fixes)

Method.evidence: Every row read from its own IL through NameCandidates --inspect-methods. Four namespaces in one wave: Plugin (the ETS3/ETS4 plugin hosts and the device plugin wrapper), Operations.SplitAndMerge (the merge/split operations, their validation result and the XML conflict report), Operations.GroupAddressRefs (the link/add/unlink group address ref operations) and Operations.Filtertable (the filter table calculator and its XML creators).
Method.collisions fixed: The first run suffixed two rows because PluginWrapper already declares HasParameterDialog/HasContextMenuItems, so they were re-issued as IsParameterDialogAvailable and IsContextMenuAvailable; the re-run reports 40 changes with 0 collision suffixes.
Method.state machines: MergeProjectsOperationBase's iterator is <GetValidatorsInternal>d__23 and SplitProjectOperation's is <GetValidators>d__9, so those rows carry the original names.
Method.log strings: Ets3Plugin warns "ETS3 custom report entries of device '{0}' contains empty label at index {1}" and PluginWrapper logs "'{0}' of {1} failed: {2}" before resetting the installation state; XmlConflictReportGenerator writes the SplitAndMergeReport document with its MasterProject/SplitProject nodes.
